claim.claim-text: 1. A 3D printing apparatus of the bottom-up photo-curing type, comprising
2. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the first polarization is linear polarization and/or wherein the second polarization is linear polarization.

3. The apparatus of claim 1 or 2, wherein the first source (12) is associated with a polarizer (23) configured to allow passage of only the portion of radiation of the first source (12) which has linear polarization oriented according to a given angle, particularly when the photo curing radiation of the first source (12) has no linear polarization.

4. The apparatus of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the second source (13) is associated with a polarizer configured to allow passage of only the portion of radiation of the second source (13) which has linear polarization oriented according to an angle orthogonal to the polarization of the first source (12), particularly when the photo curing radiation of the second source (13) has no linear polarization.
5. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the photocuring radiation of the first source (12) is same or similar to the photocuring radiation of the second source (13), and vice versa.

6. The apparatus of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the second source (13) is configured to vary the radiating flux power, and/or wherein the or a laser deflection means of the second source has variable speed.

7. The apparatus of claim 6, comprising a controller configured to control the radiating flux power and the speed of the laser deflection means as a function of the time required for the photo-curing of each layer by means of the first source (12), wherein the controller particularly comprises a software, particularly a CAD-CAM/Slicer software.
8. The apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the laser deflection means comprises a galvanometric head (18).
9. The apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the second source (13) of photo-curing radiation, of laser type, comprises a variable power diode (17).

10. The apparatus of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the polarising beam combiner (19) is capable of transmitting one polarisation state, e.g. p-polariation, and reflecting a polarisation state orthogonal thereto, e.g. s-polarisation, particularly to form a resulting beam comprising the same wavelength as the radiation of the first source (12) and the second source (13).

11. The apparatus of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the polarising beam combiner (19) configured to spatially superimpose the radiation of the first source (12) and the radiation of the second source (13) along a same direction of propagation.
12. A 3D printing method of the bottom-up photo-curing type, implemented by the apparatus of the preceding claims, comprising the following steps:

13. The method of claim 12, wherein comprising setting the speed of a laser deflection means associated with the second source (13) so that it goes through the contour of the layer to be formed in a time equal to the time required for the photo-curing of the same layer by the first source (12).
14. The method of claim 12 or 13, comprising setting the power of the irradiating flux of the second source (13) according to the set speed of the laser deflection means.
